turns.content: Before classifying the molecules, distinguish the Schoenflies groups C3, C3v, C3h, and D3h by the presence or absence of a C3 principal axis, a horizontal mirror plane, vertical mirror planes, and perpendicular C2 axes.
Start with triisopropyl borate and quinuclidine. From their C3 axes and mirror planes, determine the idealized point group of each molecule.

Next analyze benzo[1,2-c:3,4-c':5,6-c'']trifuran-1,3,4,6,7,9-hexaone. Check for a horizontal mirror plane, vertical mirror planes, and C2 axes perpendicular to C3 before assigning its idealized point group.
Apply the same symmetry-element analysis to triphenyleno[1,2-c:5,6-c':9,10-c'']trifuran-1,3,6,8,11,13-hexaone and determine its idealized point group.
Compare the two fused-ring molecules directly. Which has C3 and sigma_h but lacks the perpendicular C2 axes and vertical mirrors, and which has the additional elements required for D3h?
Summarize the idealized point group of each of the four molecules, then identify the molecule with C3h symmetry.
